title: Great kit for doing “real” chemistry
text: This was an excellent kit - my son especially appreciated that it was real materials to work with, not “kids’ science kit”-style “grab some table salt and soap” experiments. He did go through it extremely quickly, so we wished there were even more extension ideas in the kit, but overall it was a great experience.  He also loved the VR models, though I think that part might have been a bit above his level!
label: positive
